name: XDG Utils with host browser pipe
description: Installs xdg-utils and wraps xdg-open to forward URLs to the host browser through a unix pipe; when the pipe is absent, xdg-open falls back to the real /usr/bin/xdg-open. The host browser pipe is a host bind mount that this feature does not declare (paths are machine-specific); the consuming devcontainer.json must bind the hostBrowserPipePath to the containerBrowserPipePath (both default to /tmp/hostbrowserpipe).

hostBrowserPipePath.description: Path of the host browser pipe. Bind this path into the container (to the containerBrowserPipePath) via a mounts entry in devcontainer.json.

containerBrowserPipePath.description: Path inside the container where the host browser pipe is mounted; the xdg-open wrapper sends URLs to this path. Declare the matching host-to-container bind mount in devcontainer.json.
